summary: Electronic patient records are crucial for efficient eye care delivery. OpenEyes addresses this need by providing a collaborative, open source EPR framework for ophthalmology and general eye care. The project aims to benefit ophthalmic units worldwide, from small practices to large hospitals, by facilitating the development of functional and easy-to-use EPRs at minimal cost. This should improve access to quality eye care services, particularly in underserved areas. The project's focus on ophthalmology and flexibility for other clinical specialties suggest relevance to healthcare systems in low- and middle-income countries.
